1981-2741-5147.easyPrerequisites:
You control an additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
1981-2741-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing any other creature you control, dealing 1 damage to yourself.
Darien triggers, causing you to create a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

2645-3430-4348-5928.easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-3430-4348-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1278-2511-3327-4508.easyPrerequisites: Lightning-Rig Crew doesn't have summoning sickness.
1278-2511-3327-4508.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least two artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
1278-2511-3327-4508.description:
Activate Lightning-Rig Crew by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure for each opponent dealt damage.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Dargo by paying {R} due to its cost reduction, including its commander tax.
Lightning-Rig Crew triggers, untapping it.
Resolve Dargo. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo to the command zone from your graveyard.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur.
Repeat.

1218-2822.easyPrerequisites: Your commander is on the battlefield and doesn't have summoning sickness.
1218-2822.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander has power 9 or greater.
An opponent cannot block your commander.
1218-2822.description:
Cast Tainted Strike by paying {B}, targeting your commander.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using your commander, which will get at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause the opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.
Kediss triggers, causing your commander to give each other opponent at least ten poison counters due to its infect. This will cause each opponent to lose the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1796-2034-4871-7147-7817.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Wretched Throng, adding {C}{C}.
When Wretched Throng dies, it and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Holding priority, activate Paradox Shaper // Omit Variables by paying {2}, putting Wretched Throng from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Wretched Throng trigger, putting Wretched Throng from your library into your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Wretched Throng by paying {U} due to Centaur Omenreader.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

855-3099-3921-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Corpsejack Menace and Winding Constrictor.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

57-206-4846-6657.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-206-4846-6657.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Gogo by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

997-3197-4120-7352.notablePrerequisites: Vigor has indestructible, protection from creatures or protection from red.
997-3197-4120-7352.description:
Cast Electric Seaweed by paying {2}{R}{R}.
When Electric Seaweed enters, it triggers.
Activate Electric Seaweed by tapping it, attempting to deal 1 damage to Herd Baloth, which will instead put a +1/+1 counter on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Electric Seaweed triggers, dealing 1 damage to each non-Wall creature your opponents control. Each non-Wall creature you control (excluding Vigor) will not be dealt damage, and will instead have a +1/+1 counter put on it due to Vigor.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 5.

628-4659-7189.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dread Tiller.
When Dread Tiller dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dread Tiller enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1636-4770-6972.notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Whitemane Lion using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
1636-4770-6972.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-4770-6972.notes: If you control mana-producing creatures, you can tap those creatures for mana instead of tapping them using the convoke ability.

1409-5420-6441.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

2085-5921-5970-7060.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Kelpie Guide.
Activate one of the Kelpie Guide tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Kelpie Guide token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1069-3168-7070.easyPrerequisites:
You control another nontoken creature.
Urza's Incubator is naming one of the additional nontoken creature's types.
1069-3168-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-3168-7070.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The equip ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0}
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2099-4907-6972.description:
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Tatterkite
When Tatterkite dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its static effect.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

275-5742-6786.easyPrerequisites: You have an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card in hand or on top of your library.
275-5742-6786.description:
Activate Mary Read and Anne Bonny by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
The discarded card is put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token.
When the Treasure enters the battlefield, Transplant Theorist triggers, causing you to draw a card and then discard an Island, Pirate or Vehicle card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

803-1399-1606-6071.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
803-1399-1606-6071.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1445-3967-4871-5631.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3967-4871-5631.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2523-5147-5561.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Relentless Rohirrim.
When Relentless Rohirrim dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Relentless Rohirrim that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Relentless Rohirrim token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Relentless Rohirrim token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

654-1170-2733-5921-5954.description:
Cast Shimmering Wings by paying {U}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Shimmering Wings spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Shimmering Wings by paying {U}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1238-2351-4050-5467-5929.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Repeat.

974-2157-2645.notablePrerequisites:
Romana II does not have summoning sickness.
There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-2157-2645.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Romana II by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Smaug with haste.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3}, untapping Romana II.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 3.

486-509-1267-3933.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
486-509-1267-3933.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
486-509-1267-3933.description:
Activate Liquimetal Torque's second ability by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact until end of turn.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Karn's Bastion's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

407-478-4853-5333-5335.description:
Activate Cabal Coffers by paying {2} and tapping it, adding seven {B}.
Activate Mirrex by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a 1/1 artifact creature token.
Activate Hecatomb by tapping an untapped Swamp you control, dealing 1 damage to the artifact creature token.
Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Candelabra of Tawnos.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Cabal Coffers, Mirrex, and a Swamp.
Repeat.
If you started the combo with at least 9 Swamps, you will generate at least one additional mana each loop, which can be used to untap additional Swamps and deal infinite damage to your opponents, or allow you to generate extra creature tokens from Mirrex.

uses.n: Jugan Defends the Temple // Remnant of the Rising Star

1747-2882-4679-4772-5299.manaNeeded: {7}{U}, plus enough mana to cast the double-faced creature or enchantment
1747-2882-4679-4772-5299.notablePrerequisites:
Yenna does not have summoning sickness.
You have a transforming double faced creature or enchantment card in hand.
1747-2882-4679-4772-5299.description:
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating two token copies of Doubling Season.
Cast Infinite Reflection by paying {5}{U}, attaching it to Jugan Defends the Temple.
When Infinite Reflection enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each nontoken creature you control to become a copy of Jugan Defends the Temple.
Cast any transforming double-faced creature or enchantment card by paying its mana cost, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Jugan Defends the Temple with four chapter counters due to Infinite Reflection and the Doubling Season tokens.
The creature or enchantment's first, second and third chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the first and second triggers, creating four 1/1 Monk creature tokens and putting four +1/+1 counters on up to two creatures.
Resolve the third trigger, exiling the creature or enchantment, and returning it to the battlefield transformed as a copy of Jugan Defends the Temple with four chapter counters due to Infinite Reflection and the Doubling Season tokens.
Repeat from step 5.
NOTE: This combo creates a mandatory infinite loop that must be interrupted, or the game will end in a draw.

2959-3101-4867.notablePrerequisites: You have an amount of mana available equal to three minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Runaway Steam-Kin.
2959-3101-4867.description:
If Runaway Steam-Kin has three or more +1/+1 counters on it, activate Runaway Steam-Kin by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Cormela by paying {1} and tapping it, adding {U}{B}{R} that can only be spent to cast instant and/or sorcery spells.
Cast Heat Shimmer by paying {2}{R}.
Runaway Steam-Kin triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Resolve Heat Shimmer, creating a token copy of Cormela.
 Put the tapped Cormela into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Cormela dies, triggering itself, returning Heat Shimmer from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

567-2161-3490-4050.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
567-2161-3490-4050.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

2353-2498-4691.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
2353-2498-4691.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet and Sheoldred's first ability trigger.
Resolve the Sheoldred trigger, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the Niv-Mizzet trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

3284-3490-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature you control, adding {1}
When the creature dies, Korvold's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and draw a card.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

950-2605-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Fatestitcher does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Fatestitcher.
950-2605-3525.description:
Activate Lotus Vale by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Lotus Vale.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Fatestitcher.
Repeat any number of times.
Repeat steps with a different color for infinite mana of any color.
